gen-fs-quilon-gf-noto-sans-batak: Editorial from the first stroke, Quilon ebbs and swells with wide-open counters in its tall a, e and s. Noto Sans Batak, with its towering x-height and wide e, keeps paragraph after paragraph approachable.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-noto-sans-bengali: Noto Sans Bengali reads contemporary and open-mouthed, with capitals that barely rise above the lowercase. Quilon then adds an editorial, commanding voice with gentle stroke contrast, making the two feel confident up top and plain below.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-noto-sans-bhaiksuki: Quilon steps softly from heavy strokes to light ones, with large open counters in its tall a, e and s. And Noto Sans Bhaiksuki, a plain sans with tight-coiled lowercase and open apertures, gives that heading a readable partner.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-noto-sans-brahmi: Wide counters up top, a high mean line below. Quilon's ebb and flow of stroke thickness meets Noto Sans Brahmi's open-ended curves, a display heading over a contemporary sans-serif body.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-noto-sans-buginese: Noto Sans Buginese leaves its letter mouths open like unjoined chalk arcs, with ascenders kept short against the body height. Quilon's medium stroke swing adds editorial command to the plain sans below.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-noto-sans-buhid: Noto Sans Buhid leaves generous space between curve ends and stems, with a high-set x-height guiding each line. And Quilon handles the commanding display work, crossbars a touch finer than its stems, while the body font simply stays open.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-noto-sans-carian: Quilon carries an editorial, commanding presence, with a comfortable level of stroke contrast. And Noto Sans Carian, plain sans with terminals held apart like open scissor blades, keeps everything beneath it clean and professional.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-noto-sans-chakma: Noto Sans Chakma reads approachable, its lowercase packed up toward the caps and its s and c left open and uncrowded. Quilon's tempered contrast leads, and long text stays comfortable.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-noto-sans-cherokee: Noto Sans Cherokee reads tall and friendly: a band of letters under short stalks, its e gapped wide at the terminal. Quilon's mild rhythm up top keeps longer text feeling lively.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-noto-sans-chorasmian: Quilon earns its keep big and short, with strokes that taper like a candle flame, only slightly. Noto Sans Chorasmian, a contemporary sans-serif body, stops its curves short and keeps a large x-height with short ascenders.
